info.title: ATLAS ERP Lite API
info.description: Portfolio application. Same-origin Laravel Sanctum session authentication and CSRF protection. Amounts in EUR cents; VAT in basis points (2000 = 20%). All authenticated roles can read business data; administration requires admin. No real banking or accounting certification.
